use_cases: User registration with real-time password strength validation
Account settings password change with visual feedback
Login forms with show/hide password toggle
Password reset flows with requirement validation
Secure onboarding flows for SaaS applications
ai_summary: A sophisticated password input component with real-time strength validation, featuring a 5-level color-coded strength indicator, requirement checklist showing met/unmet criteria, and a toggle visibility button. Built with React hooks for state management and optimized with useMemo for performance. Clean, accessible form design suitable for authentication flows across SaaS, fintech, and e-commerce platforms.
